name: Still Engine (CR +3)
body:
The Mechanism earns its name from its mechanical vanguards, immensely powerful constructs with a boundless array of abilities. Most if not all of these constructs utilize the Mechanism’s negative energy-based technologies, known colloquially as still engines, to operate at incredible capacity and endure countless extremes. Extracting a still engine from a Mechanism construct can be a very profitable venture, provided that one survives to do so.

Still engine is an acquired template that can be applied to any construct, hereafter referred to as the base creature. A still engine construct uses the statistics of the base creature except as follows.

Challenge Rating: As base creature +3.

Aura: A still engine creature gains the following:

Aura of Stillness (Su)

A still engine is constantly surrounded by a 30-foot aura which suppresses all sound as per the silence spell and all light as per the deeper darkness spell. This aura also suppresses any senses which would be based on scent, heat, or electricity.

Senses: A still engine gains the see in darkness universal monster ability and touchsight out to 60 feet.

Armor Class: Natural armor bonus increases by 4.

Defensive Abilities: A still engine creature gains immunity to cold and sonic damage as well as fast healing 5 and the following ability:

Necrotech Fortification (Su)

A still engine creature adds its Charisma modifier to saving throws and gains additional hit points equal to its Charisma modifier multiplied by its Hit Dice. This does not stack with other abilities that would allow a construct to use its Charisma modifier to determine hit points or saving throws.

Weaknesses: A still engine creature gains the following weakness:

Negative Energy-Charged (Su)

A still engine creature takes damage from positive energy effects (including cure spells and similar effects) as if it were undead.

Ability Score Modifiers: Strength +4, Dexterity +2. If the still engine’s Charisma score is below 12, it instead becomes 12.
